title: REST API Development - Part 1
description: REST API architecture and best practices covering HTTP methods, status codes, CRUD operations, pagination, filtering, versioning, and API documentation with Swagger. This submodule covers: HTTP, HTTP methods, Status codes, REST architecture, CRUD, Request parameters.
learning_outcomes: Design RESTful APIs following architectural constraints
Implement proper HTTP methods and status codes
Handle request parameters, headers, and JSON bodies
